id: title:TueHaulund:label unrecorded video and embeds in replays

review.posthog_relevance: Replay headless implementation: these changes support accurate DOM reconstruction and metadata preservation for video and document elements, while suppressing native controls and poster attributes to prevent obscuring unrecorded labels.
review.reason: The observed changes implement a cohesive, bounded capability within the Replay headless implementation. P1.F1.H1 establishes the separation of ordinary attributes and metadata attributes on rebuilt DOM elements. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F2.H1 extend this to support video and document elements, including specific handling for poster attribute removal and native control suppression. This is,
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a substantive, bounded capability. However, the actual production benefit, such as whether this prevents specific rendering failures or improves the fidelity of recorded sessions, is not independently verified by the code comments or test assertions alone. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.

observations.behavior: Adds a loop to set non-rr_ attributes on the rebuilt DOM element, while keeping rr_* attributes only in the mirror.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay headless implementation: ensures ordinary attributes are applied to the replayed DOM while preserving rr_* metadata for the mirror, supporting accurate DOM reconstruction.

observations.behavior: Adds test cases for video, embed, and object elements, and a test asserting removal of the poster attribute from video elements.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay headless implementation: tests support for video and document elements and the removal of poster attributes, which could otherwise obscure the unrecorded label.

observations.behavior: Updates the UnrecordedKind type and LABELS object to include video and document, and adds a CSS rule to hide native media controls on video.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay headless implementation: classifies video and document elements as unrecorded and suppresses native media controls to prevent them from covering the unrecorded label.
